from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,tempfile,shutil
root=Path('products/sites/sqlite-statement-diagnostic')
for name in ['local/README.md','local/example-case.json','local/diagnose.py','llms.txt']:
 p=root/name
 print('\nFILE '+name+' SHA256 '+hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
 print(p.read_text())
print('\nHOMEPAGE\n'+(root/'index.html').read_text())
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 d=Path(td)
 for name in ['diagnose.py','example-case.json']: shutil.copyfile(root/'local'/name,d/name)
 results={}
 for label,args in [('example',['example-case.json','report.json']),('missing_arguments',[]),('invalid_json',['bad.json','bad-report.json'])]:
  (d/'bad.json').write_text('{')
  r=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','diagnose.py']+args,cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
  results[label]={'returncode':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr}
 if (d/'report.json').exists(): results['report']=json.loads((d/'report.json').read_text())
 out=Path('products/reviews/sqlite-local-download-independent/execution.json')
 out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 out.write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
 print('\nINDEPENDENT EXECUTION\n'+out.read_text())
